exam.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the target candidate has up to six months of AWS AI/ML exposure and uses but does not necessarily build solutions. Basic AWS services, shared responsibility, IAM and pricing vocabulary are useful.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions

review.notes: Revision 1.0 dated March 26, 2026 and its five detailed domain pages were reconciled with the live certification page and in-scope list. The guide explicitly covers the new agentic AI, MCP, multi-agent, memory/tool/workflow, Amazon Quick, Kiro, Strands Agents and Bedrock AgentCore scope and flags older training gaps. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 35 original checks cover rules/traditional ML/FM/agent selection, lifecycle and metrics; tokens/context/adaptation; RAG, prompting and evaluation; responsible AI; and identity, data, application, tool, monitoring and governance controls. All 25 URLs are cataloged: 23 reachable and O'Reilly/Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Product names, release stages, regions, service behavior, price and course metadata are labeled volatile, and no recalled exam questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.
